idea-plugin.name: Cat Clapping
idea-plugin.description:
Celebrate successful builds, runs, tests, debug sessions, and terminal commands with an animated clapping cat and celebration sound directly inside your IDE.

Supported triggers:

  • Run, Debug & Test configurations exiting with code 0 across PyCharm, CLion, IntelliJ IDEA, WebStorm, GoLand, and other IntelliJ-based IDEs.
  • IDE Builds (e.g. CMake, Make, Gradle, Maven) finishing successfully.
  • Integrated Terminal commands via shell integration (new Terminal), including Python (python, pytest, uv run, poetry run), C/C++ (gcc, cc, clang, g++, clang++, cl.exe, cmake, make, ninja, and compiled executables on macOS, Linux, and Windows), Node.js, Rust, Go, .NET, and Java.

Configure enabled commands, toggle audio, or preview the animation anytime under Settings → Tools → Cat Clapping.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.7

  • Fixed EDT threading violation during project startup by dispatching startup hook registration via invokeLater.

0.1.6

  • Terminal integration now uses only the public Terminal API (IDE 2025.3+); removed internal Block Terminal APIs.
  • Startup listeners migrated to ProjectActivity.
  • Minimum supported IDE version is now 2025.3.

0.1.5

  • Synchronized cat GIF frames directly to audio playback time using a custom frame-by-frame GIF decoder (CatAnimation).
  • Pre-warms audio and initial frames in the background so visual animation and sound start together.
  • Improved HiDPI/Retina rendering sharpness for the cat overlay.

0.1.4

  • Fixed Java Sound playback closing early before audio finished playing.
  • Added configurable cat overlay size and audio volume sliders in Settings → Tools → Cat Clapping.
  • Increased default cat overlay height for better visibility.

0.1.3

  • Added 40x40 SVG plugin icon and JetBrains Marketplace metadata.
  • Supports Run/Debug/Test, BuildView, and Terminal shell-integration triggers (Python, uv, and C/C++ across macOS, Linux, and Windows).
